top_signals.title: US charges Russian for infecting 80,000 freelancers with malware
top_signals.summary: A California federal grand jury has indicted a Russian national for his role in a phishing campaign that infected thousands of freelancers with TVRAT and DarkVNC malware. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: UK oil major is now seeking a new senior independent director and company secretary
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Swallows pitcher Masanori Ishikawa retiring with no regrets after 25 seasons
top_signals.summary: Ishikawa won 188 games for the Swallows, the only team he played for during his pro career.
